Hi Alexandra,

It was a pleasure hosting you; I hope you had a great time in Portland and staying with us.
It would really mean a lot to me and will help enable other great guests like yourself to find my place on Airbnb if you give me a 5 star review. I hope you feel that I earned it.
Safe travel back and I hope to welcome you back to Portland in the near future!

Jerome & Ruby

context.suggestedResponseSnippet: You're welcome, Alexandra! So glad you had a terrific trip — thank you for the kind words and the 5-star review. We'll leave you a 5-star review as well. Hope to host you again in Portland soon!
